questions.markdown: A 1-phase circuit consists of a resistance of $10\ \Omega$, an inductance of $13\ \mathrm{mH}$ and a capacitance of $150\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ connected in series. A supply of $100\ \mathrm{V}$ at $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$ is given to the circuit. Calculate the impedance, power factor of the current and power consumed in the circuit.

Two branches are connected in parallel to a $230\ \mathrm{V}$, $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$, 1-phase AC supply.

Branch 1: A coil of resistance $85\ \Omega$ and inductance of $0.617\ \mathrm{H}$

Branch 2: $35\ \Omega$ resistor in series with a $382\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor

Calculate,

i) Circuit impedance

ii) Circuit admittance

iii) Supply current

iv) Net complex power and power factor

A resistor and capacitor are in series with a variable inductor. When the circuit is connected to a $200\ \mathrm{V}$, $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$, 1-phase supply, the maximum rms current obtainable by varying the inductor is $314\ \mathrm{mA}$. The voltage across the capacitor is then $300\ \mathrm{V}$. Determine the circuit constants $R$, $L$ and $C$.

A star connected load of $(5 + j\ 10)\ \Omega$ per phase is connected to a balanced 3-phase, $380\ \mathrm{V}$, ABC supply. Assuming $V_{AB}$ as reference phasor obtain the line currents, load voltages, active power, reactive power, and total volt ampere.

Two wattmeters are connected to measure the power input to a 3-phase circuit, indicating $2.5\ \mathrm{kW}$ and $0.5\ \mathrm{kW}$, respectively. Find the power factor of the circuit when,

i) Both readings are positive

ii) Readings obtained after reversing the connection to the current coil of one instrument.
Sketch a one-line diagram of a power system network architecture indicating voltage levels at various stages.
Explain the operation of a transformer. Obtain the expressions for primary and secondary induced EMF in a transformer.
